name: Banner Image for post and page
author: LogicRays Technologies

sections.description:
Banner Image is a great plugin to implement custom banner Image for each page. You can set images easily and later can manage CSS from your theme.

it’s totally free.

For more features Please contact us at Logicrays
If you like this plugin Please rate us 🙂

Plugin Features

All modren browser support
works with anytype of theme
Easy to customize for developeres
Easy to configure

Shortcode

[BANNER-IMG]
sections.installation:
1. Upload Zip file banner-image to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
